correctness.rationale: Unique decomposition into alternating short runs yields the exact marked PGFs; the geometric renewal factor is common to both normalized conditional PGFs, with winner-specific truncated-geometric residuals. Their monotone likelihood ratios give stochastic order, a monotone coupling attains the Kantorovich mean lower bound for W1, and monotonicity of the residual mean proves the sharp strict uniform bound. The argument covers all integer r>=2 and all 0<p<1; an independent rational absorbing-state checker passed 4657 assertions.

value.rationale: Winner identity is a natural marked first-passage question; the exact transport metric quantifies the maximum conditional distributional information carried by which homogeneous run finishes first. The sharp universal bound is only O(r), even as the two conditional waiting times have exponentially growing means as r increases for any fixed bias. This is a structural stochastic comparison, not a routine recitation of the known joint PGF.
